title: Chakkiligintha
desc: Adi is a love guru and advises boys not to express their love for girls until they reveal their true feelings. As a challenge, Avi decides to make Adi fall in love with her.

title: Super Taxi
desc: Shiva settles for the job of a taxicab driver after quitting several odd jobs. However, things take a turn when he faces spine-chilling incidents while driving and tries to solve the mystery.

title: Yes Boss
desc: Rahul's boss, Siddharth, is a womaniser who exploits Rahul into helping him win over Seema. However, Rahul ends up falling for Seema and is torn between his career aspirations and her.

title: Masss
desc: After a life-threatening accident, a man finds that he can communicate with the dead, and must decide whether to act on their advice.
